def verify_golomb(marks):
    marks = sorted(marks)
    distances = []
    for i in range(len(marks)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(marks)):
            d = marks[j] - marks[i]
            distances.append(d)
    return len(distances) == len(set(distances)), distances
